decisions.reason: As a two-component glass flake spraying system that builds directly on the firm’s core spraying and coating know-how and remained listed in 2024, it fits existing absorptive capacity well and shows no clear sign of market withdrawal.

The low-pressure injection pump is very close to the established offer, has its own product page, and the reported test-phase field use suggests the firm can learn and improve it with its in-house R&D rather than abandon it.

This low-pressure material transfer pump reuses proven air-motor technology from the firm’s installed knowledge base, so the product is highly related to existing capabilities and therefore unlikely to be dropped soon.

Fire protection flow monitoring is somewhat more adjacent than the pump products but still leverages the firm’s system expertise and digitalization direction, and its own page in both years indicates continued commitment.

The hydraulic two-component spraying system is close to the core business, yet as a 2024 launch with only limited website evidence so far it carries the highest short-term uncertainty, though the firm’s strong related knowledge still favors keeping it.
